[USER] What is the worst thing about having something unimaginably good happen to you?  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The worst thing about having something unimaginably good happen to you is often the fear of losing it or it not lasting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The further negative consequence of losing something unimaginably good is usually disappointment, sadness, and potentially depression.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] In comparison, everything else in life may seem dull, unfulfilling, and lack meaning.
